facts.fact: Per the Auditor General's report, on 11 June 2019 the Ministry of Finance with Smart Zambia Institute contracted DotGov Solutions to design, develop and implement a national interoperability platform (Government Service Bus).

ZMB.note: Mentions an online payment gateway contract and agency resistance to online services, but no service stated launched or counted.
Article states nothing on who runs or builds systems; the platform was contracted to DotGov Solutions.
